outcome: chronic pain after clitoral reconstruction surgery
clitoral burial after clitoral reconstruction surgery
cohort: Women who underwent clitoral reconstruction after female genital mutilation/cutting (FGM/C) types 1, 2, or 3.
finding: Women with a history of physical abuse were at greater risk for chronic pain after clitoral reconstruction surgery, and younger women tended to experience more clitoral burial.
followup_time: at least 3 months after surgery (for chronic pain)
